spans.s:
Rayi is the common word for ‘wealth’ in the Rigveda and later. Special mention is often made of wealth in ‘heroes’ (vīra)--i.e., in ‘good sons,’ in horses, in cattle, etc.

Rāyo-vāja is the name of a seer of Sāmans or chants in the pañcaviṃśa brāhmaṇa (viii. 1, 4; xiii. 4, 17; cf. xxiv. 1, 7).
